title: He walked on and on through ill-lit streets
html_source:
The speaker saying that Stephen walked on and on makes the walk appear somewhat tedious, that it went on and on and on and on etc.

Now consider how Stephen has this great weight from his spiritual “revelations” and how this would feel on a prolonged walk… Rather cumbersome… Now add the fact of ill-lit streets and his surroundings in general, pretty tense for someone who is thinking that he may or may not be damned for eternity based on his coming actions…

Streets that follow like a tedious argument
Of insidious intent
To lead you to an overwhelming question …
